plan.title: SRC-BID-034 — RFQ locked before technical response

steps.note: Open the prepared Tech+RFQ event without changing its live state.
Move to Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while leaving the buyer session available.
Attempt to open the commercial RFQ stage before submitting the technical response.
Try to submit a quote and require evidence that the RFQ is locked or the submission is refused until the technical response is completed.
